title: 孤城逐晓 · 封闭测试
description: 四人协作塔防与生存。建造城防、培养英雄，应对不断增强的怪物波次，并挑战无尽模式。本条目用于受限测试，暂不开放真实付费。
notes: The one authorized v08 update attempt of the same unlisted item3824360109 failed at official SubmitItemUpdate callback3404 with EResult2. v08 is not marked uploaded; the original pending journal and full prior backup are preserved without retry or rollback.

v06 hardens payment/exchange HTTP failure, timeout and late-reply cleanup and shared menu/owner lifecycle handling; v07 adds event-driven font fallback/readiness and authoritative daily/wallet cache invalidation. Business prices, balances and reward rules are preserved.
